rubric_items.deep_module: pass — the new towkamap exporter is one function that hides directory/group/globals/templating generation, and the extractor hides one ssh batch, array serialization and cache write behind one batch-fetch entry plus one cache writer; no spread of shallow wrappers over one mechanism.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — the §7 reconstruction gate re-implements model-vs-reference equilibrium scoring that imas_ambix/eval/efit_referee.py:judge_geometry already owns.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; every section that adds surface (§2 exporter, §3 extractor+cache, §7 EQDB reader) states in its own text "it retires nothing, because ...", and §3 adds that it adds no `ambix data` command.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — the plan names the "MAST benchmark pattern" and "the ambix convention scorer" as machinery it reuses, but the concrete owners are not cited and the scorer as shipped (imas_ambix/challenge/convention.py) is bound to the DIII-D corpus schema it cannot read SELENE through.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — each new thin layer states in its own text why the existing mechanism cannot be extended instead (the loaders must not learn towkamap; importing imas-codex's remote layer would make it a runtime dependency of every ambix read; the cache shares the path owner and zarr layout but takes none of the manifest/download machinery).
